---
title: "Presentation Title"
subtitle: "Subtitle goes here"
author: "Author Name"
date: 2026-03-21
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, custom.scss]
    slide-number: true
    slide-tone: false
    embed-resources: true
    slide-level: 2
    center: false
    auto-stretch: false
    min-scale: 0.2
    max-scale: 1.5
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script>
          document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            // Fix viewport for mobile pinch-to-zoom
            var vp = document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]');
            if (vp) vp.setAttribute('content', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=10.0, user-scalable=yes');

            // Fix menu plugin accessibility
            var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations, obs) {
              var nav = document.querySelector('.slide-menu-wrapper nav.slide-menu');
              if (!nav) return;
              obs.disconnect();

              // Label the nav element
              nav.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Slide navigation menu');

              // Fix toolbar: make it a tablist with proper tab roles
              var toolbar = nav.querySelector('ol.slide-menu-toolbar');
              if (toolbar) {
                toolbar.setAttribute('role', 'tablist');
                toolbar.querySelectorAll('li.toolbar-panel-button').forEach(function(li) {
                  li.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
                  li.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                  var label = li.querySelector('.slide-menu-toolbar-label');
                  if (label) li.setAttribute('aria-label', label.textContent);
                });
              }

              // Fix slide list: make it a menu with menuitems
              nav.querySelectorAll('.slide-menu-items').forEach(function(ul) {
                ul.setAttribute('role', 'menu');
              });
              nav.querySelectorAll('.slide-menu-item').forEach(function(li) {
                li.setAttribute('role', 'menuitem');
                li.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                var title = li.querySelector('.slide-menu-item-title');
                if (title) li.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide: ' + title.textContent);
              });

              // Fix tool items: ensure links have proper labels
              nav.querySelectorAll('.slide-tool-item a').forEach(function(a) {
                a.setAttribute('role', 'button');
              });

              // Fix the menu open button (hamburger)
              var menuBtn = document.querySelector('.slide-menu-button a');
              if (menuBtn) {
                menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open slide navigation menu');
                menuBtn.setAttribute('role', 'button');
              }

              // Hide menu from screen readers and tab order when closed
              var wrapper = document.querySelector('.slide-menu-wrapper');
              if (wrapper) {
                wrapper.inert = true;
                var menuObserver = new MutationObserver(function() {
                  var isOpen = nav.classList.contains('active');
                  wrapper.inert = !isOpen;
                  if (isOpen) {
                    // Move focus into the menu so screen readers can navigate it
                    var firstItem = nav.querySelector('[role="tab"], [role="menuitem"]');
                    if (firstItem) setTimeout(function() { firstItem.focus(); }, 50);
                  } else {
                    // Move focus to the current slide's heading or section
                    setTimeout(function() {
                      var current = document.querySelector('.reveal .slides section.present');
                      if (current) {
                        var heading = current.querySelector('h1, h2, h3');
                        if (heading) {
                          heading.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
                          heading.focus();
                        } else {
                          current.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
                          current.focus();
                        }
                      }
                    }, 100);
                  }
                });
                menuObserver.observe(nav, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
              }
            });
            observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

            // Fix: reveal.js's aria-live region dumps full slide text, causing
            // screen readers to read everything twice. Replace with a brief
            // announcement (slide title + number) so users know they moved
            // without hearing the entire slide repeated.
            var statusObs = new MutationObserver(function() {
              var statusDiv = document.querySelector('.aria-status');
              if (!statusDiv) return;
              statusObs.disconnect();

              // Override the content reveal.js puts in the aria-live region.
              // Disconnect before writing to prevent infinite loop, then reconnect.
              function observeStatus() {
                contentObs.observe(statusDiv, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
              }
              var contentObs = new MutationObserver(function() {
                contentObs.disconnect();
                var slide = Reveal.getCurrentSlide();
                if (!slide) { observeStatus(); return; }
                var heading = slide.querySelector('h1, h2, h3');
                var title = heading ? heading.textContent.trim() : '';
                var indices = Reveal.getIndices();
                var label = 'Slide ' + (indices.h + 1);
                if (title) label += ': ' + title;
                statusDiv.textContent = label;
                observeStatus();
              });
              observeStatus();
            });
            statusObs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

            // Fix: Quarto video shortcode creates iframes without title attribute
            document.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(function(iframe) {
              if (!iframe.title) {
                var src = iframe.src || '';
                if (src.includes('youtube')) {
                  // Use the slide heading as context
                  var slide = iframe.closest('section');
                  var heading = slide && slide.querySelector('h2');
                  iframe.title = heading ? 'Video: ' + heading.textContent.trim() : 'Embedded video';
                } else {
                  iframe.title = 'Embedded content';
                }
              }
            });
          });
          </script>
    axe:
      output: console
title-slide-attributes:
  data-background-color: "#00274C"
